title: the web server's own proofs carry its trouble render and trouble rows teeth
intention: Four teeth that measure web_server code stand in other devices' proofs: the trouble render teeth (two-sided layout, red light bright and dull, escaping) in cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_trouble_panel.py:155-188, and the socket rows read with no bus in cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py:302. They berth in web_server's own proofs, so cairn and trouble can drop their reaches into web_server without losing a tooth.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds trouble names cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_trouble_panel.py:155,168,178,188,223,306 and cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py:302 importing cairn.devices.web_server. Those teeth measure web_server's render and listener; RULE 1 says a ticket's proofs measure only that component, so they berth beside web_server before the other two proofs drop them.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 15.3 (the web server renders what devices declare and owns nothing); outline 17.13.1.
how: New proof cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_the_web_server_renders_and_reads_troubles.py with four teeth: render_pane over a trouble pane is two-sided; the red light is #d33 over live rows and #998 over none; ids and whys are escaped; listener._trouble_rows over a seeded scratch store with bus_client.reach refused returns the live top (unreadable surfaced, cleared left out, four keys a row) and an absent store raises.

clauses.claim: the trouble pane renders two-sided: a trouble-list, a trouble-detail and a red-light
the red light is bright (#d33) over live troubles and dull (#998) over none
every value a trouble carries renders escaped, never as live markup
the socket's trouble rows read a seeded store with every bus dial refused: the live top with an unreadable file surfaced, cleared troubles left out, four keys a row; an absent store raises

decisions.text: D1: copy the teeth here rather than move them in one ticket: each ticket edits only its own component, so the cairn and trouble tickets drop their copies after this one proves.
